# Sinyx

Sinyx builds practical software products for modern workflows, including developer APIs, automation tools, AI utilities, digital products, and managed workflow services.

## Primary Pages

- Homepage: https://sinyx.me/
- Products: https://sinyx.me/products
- Services: https://sinyx.me/services
- API docs: https://sinyx.me/docs
- MCP setup: https://sinyx.me/mcp
- Pricing: https://sinyx.me/pricing
- Terms of Service: https://sinyx.me/tos
- Privacy Policy: https://sinyx.me/privacy

## Current Product

The current Sinyx product line is Web Context API: public web pages to Markdown, plain text, readable HTML, full metadata, semantic chunks, and source-aware context for AI and automation workflows.

## API Access

API keys, subscriptions, usage limits, and billing are managed through RapidAPI:
https://rapidapi.com/ibasitkhan98/api/sinyx/pricing

## Core Endpoints

- POST https://sinyx.p.rapidapi.com/v1/extract
- POST https://sinyx.p.rapidapi.com/v1/extract/batch

## Output Formats

- context
- markdown
- text
- html
- full
- chunks
